action.headline_en: Press 2: Cone hydraulic fault. Check the cone hydraulics now.
action.headline_ms: Penekan 2: Kerosakan hidraulik kon. Semak hidraulik kon sekarang.

reasons.text_en: Cone hydraulic pressure is 5% above Press 2's normal
reasons.text_ms: Tekanan hidraulik kon 5% lebih tinggi daripada biasa bagi Penekan 2

reasons.text_en: Motor current is 0% below Press 2's normal
reasons.text_ms: Arus motor 0% lebih rendah daripada biasa bagi Penekan 2

reasons.text_en: Oil lost in fibre is 2.5% (alarm line is 4%)
reasons.text_ms: Kehilangan minyak dalam serabut ialah 2.5% (garis amaran 4%)

diagnosis.plain_en: The hydraulic system that holds the pressing cone is unstable, so the squeeze on the fruit swings up and down.
diagnosis.plain_ms: Sistem hidraulik yang menahan kon penekan tidak stabil, jadi tekanan pada buah berayun naik turun.

steps_en: Check the hydraulic oil level and look for leaks on hoses and fittings.
Watch the cone pressure gauge for swings while running.
At the stop, replace leaking hoses and worn seals.
Change the hydraulic filter and top up with the right oil grade.
Test the cone pressure under load before handing back.
steps_ms: Semak paras minyak hidraulik dan cari kebocoran pada hos dan penyambung.
Perhatikan tolok tekanan kon untuk ayunan semasa berjalan.
Pada waktu henti, tukar hos bocor dan sesendal haus.
Tukar penapis hidraulik dan tambah minyak gred yang betul.
Uji tekanan kon dengan beban sebelum diserahkan semula.
